short_description: A hinging triceps extension that isolates the back of the upper arm.
how_to: Hinge forward at the hips with a flat back and a slight bend in your knees.
Tuck your upper arms close to your sides with your elbows bent.
Straighten your arms behind you until they are fully extended.
Bend your elbows to return and repeat.
correct: Keep your upper arms still throughout the movement.
Keep your back flat and your core engaged.
Keep your elbows close to your sides.
Move in a slow, controlled arc.
mistakes: Don't swing your arms to generate momentum.
Don't round your back.
Don't let your upper arms drop during the extension.
Don't rush the return phase.

short_description: A glute bridge variation that adds a leg lift to challenge the glutes and core.
how_to: Lie on your back with your knees bent and feet flat on the floor.
Press through your heels and lift your hips into a bridge.
Extend one leg straight out at knee height.
Lower the leg, then lower your hips and repeat on each side.
correct: Keep your hips level when you lift your leg.
Keep your supporting foot flat on the floor.
Keep your core braced throughout.
Squeeze your glutes at the top of the bridge.
mistakes: Don't let your hips sag when you extend the leg.
Don't rush through the movement.
Don't let your lower back arch excessively.
Don't hold your breath.

short_description: A reverse lunge that strengthens the quads, glutes and hamstrings.
how_to: Stand tall with your feet together.
Step one foot back and lower your back knee toward the floor.
Stop when your front thigh is parallel to the floor.
Push through your front heel to stand back up and repeat on the other side.
correct: Keep your knees over your toes.
Keep your heels down on your front foot.
Keep your torso upright throughout.
Keep your core engaged.
mistakes: Don't let your knees cave inward.
Don't drop too fast.
Don't lean your torso forward.
Don't let your front heel lift off the floor.

short_description: A lateral raise that targets the medial deltoids and builds shoulder width.
how_to: Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart and your arms at your sides.
Keep a soft bend in your elbows.
Raise both arms out to the sides until they reach shoulder height.
Lower them slowly back down and repeat.
correct: Keep your arms at or just below shoulder height at the top.
Keep a slight bend in your elbows throughout.
Keep your shoulders relaxed, not shrugged.
Control the lowering phase.
mistakes: Don't swing your arms up with momentum.
Don't shrug your shoulders at the top.
Don't raise your arms above shoulder height.
Don't let your torso lean side to side.

short_description: An inverted push-up performed lying on your back that works the chest and triceps.
how_to: Lie on your back and place your hands on the floor beside your chest, fingers pointing toward your shoulders.
Press your palms into the floor and lift your torso off the ground.
Straighten your arms as fully as comfortable.
Lower back down with control and repeat.
correct: Keep your body straight.
Keep your elbows controlled as you press.
Keep your core engaged throughout.
Move at a steady, deliberate pace.
mistakes: Don't let your hips drop toward the floor.
Don't flare your elbows out wide.
Don't rush the lowering phase.
Don't hold your breath.

short_description: A prone back extension that strengthens the erector spinae and glutes.
how_to: Lie face down with your arms extended in front or crossed behind your head.
Engage your glutes and core.
Lift your chest and legs off the floor simultaneously.
Hold briefly at the top, then lower with control.
correct: Keep your neck neutral.
Move with control.
Keep your glutes and core engaged throughout.
Keep the lift moderate rather than extreme.
mistakes: Don't throw your head back.
Don't over-arch your lower back.
Don't hold your breath at the top.
Don't jerk your body up with momentum.

short_description: A plank variation with an alternating leg raise that challenges the core and glutes.
how_to: Start in a forearm plank with your elbows under your shoulders.
Keep your body in a straight line from head to heels.
Lift one leg toward the ceiling, keeping it straight.
Lower it and repeat on the other side.
correct: Keep your body in one line.
Keep your core engaged throughout.
Keep your hips level when you raise each leg.
Breathe steadily.
mistakes: Don't let your lower back sag.
Don't lift your hips too high.
Don't rotate your hips when you raise your leg.
Don't hold your breath.

short_description: A bodyweight pull that activates the rhomboids and middle trapezius to improve posture.
how_to: Stand or sit tall with your arms extended forward at shoulder height.
Pull your elbows back and squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Hold the squeeze for a moment.
Return your arms forward with control and repeat.
correct: Keep your shoulders down, away from your ears.
Focus the effort between your shoulder blades.
Keep your chest open at the end of each pull.
Breathe steadily.
mistakes: Don't shrug your shoulders up as you pull.
Don't use momentum to swing your arms back.
Don't round your upper back on the return.
Don't hold your breath.

short_description: A cross-body stretch that releases tension in the rear deltoid and upper back.
how_to: Stand or sit tall.
Bring one arm straight across your chest.
Use your opposite hand to gently press the arm closer to your chest.
Hold the stretch, then repeat on the other side.
correct: Keep your shoulder down, not hunched.
Keep your spine upright throughout.
Breathe steadily into the stretch.
Hold for several slow breaths.
mistakes: Don't rotate your torso to reach further.
Don't force the stretch.
Don't hold your breath.
Don't hunch your upper back.

short_description: An all-fours glute kick that isolates and strengthens the glutes.
how_to: Start on all fours with your hands under your shoulders and your knees under your hips.
Keep your core engaged and your back flat.
Drive one heel toward the ceiling, keeping your knee bent at 90 degrees.
Lower it with control and repeat, then switch sides.
correct: Keep your hips square to the floor.
Keep your core engaged to stabilise your lower back.
Keep your knee bent throughout the movement.
Move with control rather than swinging your leg.
mistakes: Don't rotate your hips when you kick up.
Don't let your lower back arch excessively.
Don't kick so high that you lose control.
Don't rush through the reps.
